name: project-tracker
description: Resumable, auditable per-project archives for long-horizon work that spans many sessions.

plugins.name: project-tracker
plugins.description: 为跨多次会话的长期任务在全局目录 ~/.claude/project/<slug>/ 建立可恢复、可审计的档案，按 Workdir 隔离，一个会话只加载一个项目（charter/plan/state/journal/decisions），新会话冷启动时用 5 行汇报恢复上下文。Use when a task spans multiple sessions and its goal, plan, state and decisions must survive between them.
